paragraphs.title: Keturah’s Family and the Growth of the Family

easy.question: What was the name of the woman Abraham took as his wife?
easy.explanation: The verse says, “Her name was Keturah.”

easy.question: How many sons did Keturah bear Abraham, according to the verse?
easy.explanation: Six sons are listed: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

easy.question: Who was the father of Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abidah, and Eldaah?
easy.explanation: The verse says, “The sons of Midian,” and then lists their names.

medium.question: What was the family relationship between Jokshan, Sheba, and Dedan?
medium.explanation: The verse says, “Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan.”

medium.question: In the phrase “Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan,” what does “begat” mean?
medium.explanation: In this context, “begat” means that Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan.

medium.question: Which sequence correctly describes the family line in these verses?
answers: Dedan fathered Jokshan, and Jokshan fathered Keturah
Midian fathered Abraham, and Abraham fathered Ephah
Abraham fathered Jokshan, Jokshan fathered Dedan, and Dedan fathered sons
medium.explanation: The verses identify Abraham as Jokshan’s father, Jokshan as Dedan’s father, and Dedan as the father of several sons.

challenge.question: Which of the following was not a direct son of Abraham according to this list?
challenge.explanation: Dedan was Jokshan’s son, while Midian and Shuah were listed among Abraham’s sons by Keturah.

challenge.question: What can we conclude from the fact that the Torah lists both Dedan’s sons and Midian’s sons?
answers: The family grew through several generations and branches
challenge.explanation: The verses move from Abraham’s sons to the descendants of Jokshan and Dedan, showing the family branching across generations.

challenge.question: Which detail helps distinguish Abraham’s sons from descendants of later generations?
answers: The word “sons” appears only for Abraham’s sons
“Begat” identifies a parent-child relationship, while “sons” identifies the father’s descendants
The names of later descendants are always singular
challenge.explanation: “Begat” identifies Jokshan as the father of Sheba and Dedan, while “the sons of Dedan” identifies Dedan’s children.

questions.question: Which of the following was not a direct son of Abraham according to this list?
questions.explanation: Dedan was Jokshan’s son, while Midian and Shuah were listed among Abraham’s sons by Keturah.

questions.question: What can we conclude from the fact that the Torah lists both Dedan’s sons and Midian’s sons?
answers: The family grew through several generations and branches
questions.explanation: The verses move from Abraham’s sons to the descendants of Jokshan and Dedan, showing the family branching across generations.

questions.question: Which detail helps distinguish Abraham’s sons from descendants of later generations?
answers: The word “sons” appears only for Abraham’s sons
“Begat” identifies a parent-child relationship, while “sons” identifies the father’s descendants
The names of later descendants are always singular
questions.explanation: “Begat” identifies Jokshan as the father of Sheba and Dedan, while “the sons of Dedan” identifies Dedan’s children.

paragraphs.title: The Inheritance and Separation from the Sons of the Concubines

easy.question: To whom did Abraham give everything he owned?
easy.explanation: The verse says, “Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.”

easy.question: What did Abraham give the sons of the concubines?
easy.explanation: The verse says that Abraham gave them gifts.

easy.question: Where did Abraham send the sons of the concubines?
easy.explanation: He sent them eastward, to the east country.

medium.question: In the phrase “the sons of the concubines,” what does “concubines” refer to?
medium.explanation: The context refers to women Abraham had children by, whose sons received gifts.

medium.question: What was the difference between what Isaac received and what the sons of the concubines received?
answers: Isaac received gifts, while they received everything
Isaac received everything Abraham owned, while they received gifts
Isaac received nothing, while they received the land
medium.explanation: The verses distinguish between Isaac’s full inheritance and the gifts given to the other sons.

medium.question: When did Abraham send the sons of the concubines away?
medium.explanation: The verse explicitly says he sent them away while he was still alive.

challenge.question: What can we conclude from Isaac receiving everything while the other sons received gifts and were sent away?
answers: The other sons were older than Isaac
Isaac moved to the east country
challenge.explanation: The distribution of Abraham’s property distinguishes Isaac as the primary heir.

challenge.question: What does the phrase “while he yet lived” emphasize?
answers: Abraham did not know his sons
Abraham arranged the distribution and separation before his death
The sons returned after his death
challenge.explanation: It emphasizes that these actions took place while Abraham was still alive.

challenge.question: Which detail identifies the direction in which they were sent?
challenge.explanation: “Eastward” and “the east country” indicate the direction.

questions.question: What can we conclude from Isaac receiving everything while the other sons received gifts and were sent away?
answers: The other sons were older than Isaac
Isaac moved to the east country
questions.explanation: The distribution of Abraham’s property distinguishes Isaac as the primary heir.

answers: Abraham did not know his sons
Abraham arranged the distribution and separation before his death
The sons returned after his death
questions.explanation: It emphasizes that these actions took place while Abraham was still alive.

questions.question: Which detail identifies the direction in which they were sent?
questions.explanation: “Eastward” and “the east country” indicate the direction.

easy.question: Who died and was buried according to these verses?
easy.explanation: The verses describe Abraham’s death and burial.

easy.question: How old was Abraham when he died?
easy.explanation: Abraham lived 175 years.

easy.question: Where was Abraham buried?
easy.explanation: The verse says that Abraham was buried in the cave of Machpelah.

medium.question: What can we learn from Isaac and Ishmael burying Abraham?

medium.explanation: The verse explicitly names both Isaac and Ishmael as those who buried Abraham.

medium.question: What does the phrase “gave up the ghost” mean in “Abraham gave up the ghost, and died”?
medium.explanation: The phrase appears together with “died,” so it means that Abraham passed away.

medium.question: What is the order of events described in these verses?
answers: Abraham was buried, then died, and finally his age was given
Abraham was born, went to Egypt, and was buried
Abraham lived many years, died, and was then buried
medium.explanation: The passage gives his years, then describes his death, and finally his burial.

challenge.question: What does verse 10 teach about Abraham’s connection to the burial place?
answers: Abraham bought the field from the sons of Heth
Ishmael gave the field to Abraham
The field always belonged to Isaac
challenge.explanation: The verse emphasizes that Abraham purchased the field from the sons of Heth.

challenge.question: What is the best meaning of “an old man, and full of years” in the description of Abraham?
answers: Old, with a full and fulfilled life
challenge.explanation: The phrase describes someone who reached old age after a long, full life.

challenge.question: Which is the most accurate description of Abraham’s burial place?
answers: A field Isaac bought in Gerar
The cave of Machpelah in the field of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre
challenge.explanation: The verses specify the cave, the field’s owner, and its location before Mamre.

questions.question: What does verse 10 teach about Abraham’s connection to the burial place?
answers: Abraham bought the field from the sons of Heth
Ishmael gave the field to Abraham
The field always belonged to Isaac
questions.explanation: The verse emphasizes that Abraham purchased the field from the sons of Heth.

questions.question: What is the best meaning of “an old man, and full of years” in the description of Abraham?
answers: Old, with a full and fulfilled life
questions.explanation: The phrase describes someone who reached old age after a long, full life.

questions.question: Which is the most accurate description of Abraham’s burial place?
answers: A field Isaac bought in Gerar
The cave of Machpelah in the field of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre
questions.explanation: The verses specify the cave, the field’s owner, and its location before Mamre.

paragraphs.title: Isaac’s Blessing after His Father’s Death

easy.question: Who blessed Isaac?
easy.explanation: The verse says, “God blessed his son Isaac.”

easy.question: What happened before God blessed Isaac?
easy.explanation: The verse begins, “After the death of Abraham,” and then describes the blessing.

easy.question: Where did Isaac dwell?
easy.explanation: The verse says that Isaac dwelt by the well Lahairoi.

Abraham blessed Isaac before he died
medium.explanation: The verse clearly presents Abraham’s death first and God’s blessing afterward.

challenge.question: What does the word “son” emphasize in the description of Isaac?
challenge.explanation: The word identifies Isaac’s family relationship to Abraham.

challenge.question: What does “by the well Lahairoi” tell us about Lahairoi?

Isaac was no longer Abraham’s son

questions.question: What does “by the well Lahairoi” tell us about Lahairoi?
answers: It was a person who lived with Isaac
It was a city in Egypt
It was the place where Isaac lived

easy.question: Who was Ishmael’s firstborn son?

easy.question: How many princes did Ishmael’s sons become?

easy.question: Who is described in verses 17–18?
easy.explanation: The passage describes Ishmael’s life and death.

easy.question: How old was Ishmael when he died?
easy.explanation: The verse says Ishmael lived 137 years.

easy.question: Between which places did Ishmael’s descendants dwell?

medium.question: What is described after Ishmael’s death?
answers: The dwelling place of his sons and descendants
medium.explanation: The phrase “they dwelt” describes where Ishmael’s descendants lived.

medium.question: What does “gave up the ghost” mean in “he gave up the ghost and died”?

medium.question: What do the numbers “an hundred and thirty and seven years” add up to?

Because it was time for delivery

The elder will serve the younger
